SELECT * FROM app.emergency_contact WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.emergency_contact(employee_id, name, relationship, phone, address, priority, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{employeeId}, #{name}, #{relationship}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{priority}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.emergency_contact SET name = #{name}, relationship = #{relationship}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
